question: Which additional groups and presiding powers are to be included in the arrangement?
premises: The group of nine beginning with Vāmā is included.
The group beginning with the solar disk is included.
These are to be included together with their overlords.
inference: The arrangement includes the group of nine beginning with Vāmā and the group beginning with the solar disk together with their overlords.
uncertainties: The specific members of the solar-disk group are not listed.
plain_english: Include the group of nine beginning with Vāmā and the group beginning with the solar disk, together with their overlords.
